I will keep this bean plot simple because it is only 0.25 ha, and I would rather save fertilizer money for the maize fields where I see a bigger return. On beans, I do better with manure from home and good weeding, and if I can get improved seed from the market or another farmer, I will plant that because I have seen it give a better stand than local seed. I will not irrigate, and I will not spend money on chemicals on this plot unless there is a serious problem, which I do not expect. My family will handle most of the work, so I will not hire labor for this small plot.
